name: Szentkozmadombja (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szentkozmadombja: a blue and green shield with two saints and a wavy stripe, between ears of grain and an oak bough, above a yellow scroll inscribed SZENTKOZMADOMBJA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szentkozmadombja arms with grain, oak and scroll
